title: City of Waterloo flags at half-mast for CFB Wainwright
body:
City of Waterloo flags will be at half-mast to honour Sergeant Morgan Wong, Private Shaun Farrell, Private Aidan Goulding and Private Hayden Lykkemark, who lost their lives in the tragic incident at CFB Wainwright.
City of Waterloo council and staff extend condolences to the families, friends and colleagues of those who lost their lives. Our thoughts are also with those who have been injured, their fellow service members, and the entire Canadian Armed Forces community. We are grateful for the courage and commitment of those who serve our country.
